policy: These cameras are deterministic comparison cameras only. The reference says the photograph was taken from the Atomium but does not identify the observation sphere/window, exact camera coordinates, focal length, yaw, pitch or crop. Both candidates therefore remain explicitly provisional and must not be represented as the photographer position.

geometry.observation_offset_basis: The coarse runtime Atomium spheres are opaque and do not model the observation windows/interior. The deterministic comparison camera is therefore placed one official 9 m sphere radius plus 0.6 m render clearance toward the authoritative stadium target. This is a rendering-safe benchmark position, not a recovered photographer location.

must_not_infer: which Atomium observation level was used by the 2007 photographer
